Sherlock Holmes - Consulting Detective V.name: Sherlock Holmes: Consulting Detective Vol. II
Sherlock Holmes - Consulting Detective V.summary: The same structure brings a familiar look, inviting to channel all attention to the task of solving mysteries: your intelligence, skills and patience are required to find clues by listening to people, observing details, or even reading the London Times - but don't let yourself be misguided by a wrong hint.
